- Support matrix row:

## Gates

- [ ] This is scoped to one task and does not add product-specific behavior.
- [ ] Tests/typecheck/build run under the pinned toolchain.
- [ ] Security and compatibility impact is documented.
- [ ] Package tarball was audited if package files changed.
- [ ] No secrets, peer IDs, keys, `.env`, generated junk or sibling paths are included.
- [ ] `STATUS.md`, support matrix and changelog/backlog are updated as needed.

Stable publication is never implied by merge. It requires the protected release
environment and explicit operator approval described in `docs/RELEASE-POLICY.md`.
